app.title: Executive Reflexes
difficultyHint.easy: One main tension, a cooperative counterpart and optional hints. Only the primary stakeholder is in the room.
difficultyHint.medium: Conflicting incentives, hidden assumptions and realistic pressure.
difficultyHint.hard: Several constraints at once, moderate interruptions and reputational risk. The character stays the same person.
drillHint.quick_kata: Up to three exchanges under realistic pressure.
drillHint.full_simulation: A longer meeting of up to ten exchanges, bounded by your time budget.
drillHint.power_question: You get one question. Make it the one that exposes the unstated dependency.
drillHint.reframing: You receive a blunt but true statement. Say it so it keeps its rigour and can be heard.
drillHint.executive_pressure: Four exchanges with a counterpart who demands direct, decision-ready answers.
drillHint.replay: The same facts again, for an A/B comparison.
drillHint.review: Revisit a past session with the coach.
scope.user: About you (you provide and edit this)
scopeHint.coach: Hypotheses, agreements and unfinished discussions. Provisional until several sessions support them. To challenge one, talk to the coach; deleting it removes it from future prompts.
scopeHint.long_term: Outcome summaries computed by the app from stored evaluations.
scopeHint.entity: Only your own words from earlier meetings: what that person could plausibly have witnessed. Actors never receive coach notes, scores or SWOT.
notice.driving: Do not interact with the screen while driving. Always prioritize the road.
home.tagline: Spot the unvalidated premise. Say it firmly, briefly, and so it can be heard.
home.drivingHint: A spoken recap and a few questions to think about. Listening only; prepare it before you set off.
home.backupReminder: Your history lives only in this browser and can be evicted. It has been a while since your last backup.
recommend.underPracticed: Suggested because you have barely practised {skill}.
recommend.weakest: Suggested because {skill} is currently your lowest-scoring skill.
setup.title: New kata
setup.longBudget: A long budget is a ceiling, not a recommendation to train without breaks. Pauses never consume it.
content.fallback: not available in the selected content language; using {language}
session.micOn: Microphone on — take your time; pauses are fine
session.reframeInstruction: Reframe the statement above: keep the substance and the level of commitment, lose what invites defensiveness.
session.paused: Session paused. Paused time does not count against your budget.
session.outcomeNote: The outcome of the simulation is tracked separately from the quality of your intervention. A sound intervention can meet resistance, and the reverse.
session.openDialogue: Talk it through with the coach
session.replayNotice: Replay: same scenario facts, actors and rubric as the original session. The wording of the replies will differ.
session.timeExpired: Your time budget is used up. The current exchange will finish and then the kata ends.
session.providerFailed: The provider call failed. Nothing was added to the conversation.
session.noDuplicateTurns: Retrying repeats the same step; it never duplicates a turn.
eval.noReframeNeeded: No reframe needed: your wording already did the job.
eval.insufficientContext: The coach did not have enough context to score this turn.
eval.droppedQuotes: {count} quote(s) were discarded because they do not appear in the transcript
dialogue.title: Coach dialogue
dialogue.placeholder: Why did they object? What was hidden? What if I had said…?
dialogue.oocDisclaimer: An explanation from the scenario rules. It is not the psychology of a real executive, nor the hidden reasoning of a model.
dialogue.rules: The coach revises its view for new evidence or a better argument, not because of insistence. Past scores are never rewritten.
history.causalNote: Observable events and the scenario rules behind them. This is not a model's private reasoning.
history.compareWith: Compare with another run of the same scenario
compare.title: A/B comparison
compare.sameFacts: Both runs used identical scenario facts and the same rubric.
compare.differentFacts: These runs did not use identical scenario content; compare with care.
compare.caveat: A score difference between two single runs is not statistical proof of improvement.
dashboard.sparse: Only {count} evaluated session(s). Below {min}, treat every number here as an anecdote, not a pattern.
dashboard.scoreNote: Scores come from a language-model coach and vary between runs. They indicate direction, not measurement.
dashboard.signalsNote: Prompts to vary your practice, never verdicts. Repeating a valid, unresolved risk is not a flaw.
signal.lowDiversity: Your last {count} sessions used the same scenario. A new angle will test whether the skill transfers.
signal.repeatedPhrasing: Very similar phrasing recurs across sessions ({count} near-repeats). Check that you are responding to the situation rather than reciting.
signal.comfortableLevel: Results at {difficulty} have been stable and solid. It may be time to raise the difficulty.
signal.replayNotTransferring: Replays score clearly higher than first attempts at new scenarios. Practise more unfamiliar situations.
signal.longTrainingDay: You have trained about {minutes} active minutes today. A break may serve you better than another kata.
swot.title: Provisional SWOT
swot.stage.observe: Observing: {count} evaluated session(s). No hypotheses are formed before {hypothesize}.
swot.stage.hypothesize: Hypothesizing: {count} evaluated sessions. These are candidates only. A provisional SWOT needs {provisional} or more varied sessions.
swot.stage.provisional: Provisional SWOT from {count} varied sessions. It will keep changing with new evidence.
swot.disclaimer: A longitudinal working hypothesis with its evidence and counterexamples. It is not a personality test and says nothing fixed about you.
swot.underPracticed: {skill} has hardly been observed ({sessions} sessions). Choose drills that exercise it.
swot.declining: {skill} has been trending down in recent sessions.
memory.title: Memory
memory.lead: Everything the app remembers, where it came from, and who can see it. All of it stays on this device.
memory.personalization: Use my memory and profile to personalise coaching
memory.shortTermNote: Short-term memory is just the transcript of the session in progress; it is not stored separately.
memory.userHint: You are the authority on these facts. Edit them freely.
library.question: Question
library.contentLead: Actors, scenarios, coaches and profiles are Markdown files. Import your own as .md or as a .zip pack: no rebuild, no automatic translation.
library.invalidContent: Some content failed validation and is not available:
validation.too_large: The file exceeds the size limit ({max}).
validation.bad_frontmatter: The YAML frontmatter is missing or invalid.
validation.unknown_type: Unknown type “{type}”. Expected actor, scenario, coach or profile.
validation.missing_field: Required frontmatter field missing or invalid: {field}.
validation.bad_id: Invalid id “{id}”. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
validation.bad_language: Unsupported language “{language}”. Use en or es-ES.
validation.bad_pressure_level: pressure_level must be low, medium or high.
validation.actor_headings: Actor headings must be exactly the eight canonical ones, in order. Missing: {missing}. Unexpected: {extra}.
validation.bad_archive: The ZIP archive could not be read.
provider.demoNotice: Demo mode: replies and scores are scripted so you can try the flow offline. It is not real coaching.
provider.dataLeavesDevice: Bring your own key. What you say in a session is sent directly from this browser to the provider you choose; its retention policy is outside this app's control. There is no intermediate server.
provider.keyFromEnv: The key for this provider was loaded from your local .env file for this build. It is kept in memory only.
provider.apiKeyHint: Kept in memory for this tab only, unless you choose to store it below. Never included in sessions, exports or logs.
provider.persistKey: Remember the key on this device
provider.persistWarning: Browser storage is not a secure vault. Anyone with access to this browser profile, or any script that compromised this origin, could read a stored key. Prefer a restricted, low-limit key.
provider.baseUrlHint: Direct browser access depends on the endpoint's CORS policy. No proxy is used.
provider.actorModelHint: Leave empty for the default. A faster model keeps spoken turns snappy.
provider.coachModelHint: Leave empty to use the same model as the actor. The coach always runs in a separate context.
error.auth: The provider rejected the API key.
error.rate_limit: The provider is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment and retry.
error.network: The provider could not be reached. Check your connection; some providers block direct browser calls (CORS).
error.bad_request: The provider rejected the request. Check the model name and endpoint.
error.server: The provider had an internal error. Retry shortly.
error.truncated: The reply was cut off. Retry.
error.no_key: No API key is loaded for the selected provider. Add it in Settings.
error.invalid_output: The model's reply did not pass validation and was discarded. Retry.
error.actor_not_found: An actor required by this scenario is not available.
error.session_snapshot_missing: This session's content snapshot is incomplete.
error.backup_too_large: The file is too large to import.
error.backup_unreadable: The file could not be read.
error.backup_not_recognized: This is not an Executive Reflexes backup.
error.backup_newer_version: This backup was made by a newer version of the app.
speech.unsupported: This browser does not offer both speech recognition and speech synthesis. You can still train by typing, with captions.
speech.ttsNo: Speech synthesis is not available in this browser.
speech.sttNo: Speech recognition is not available in this browser; typing is used instead.
speech.wakeLockYes: The screen can be kept awake during spoken sessions.
speech.noWakeLock: This browser cannot keep the screen awake; adjust your device's auto-lock for long sessions.
speech.backgroundLimit: Keeping the screen awake does not guarantee audio or microphone once the screen is locked or the app is in the background, especially on iOS.
speech.error.not_supported: Speech recognition is not supported here. Type your response instead.
speech.error.permission: Microphone access was denied or is unavailable. Type your response, or allow the microphone in the browser settings.
speech.error.no_speech: Nothing was heard. Try again or type your response.
speech.error.network: The speech recognition service could not be reached. Type your response instead.
speech.error.unknown: Speech recognition failed. Type your response instead.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Executive Reflexes
onboarding.lead: A practice gym for the moment in a meeting when something does not add up. Short spoken katas against simulated executives, with an independent coach. The aim is influence without losing rigour, not politeness.
onboarding.roleHint: For example: CTO, technical advisor, engineering director.
onboarding.objectives: What you want to get better at
onboarding.objectivesHint: In your own words. The coach reads this; the simulated executives never do.
onboarding.profile: Optional: more about how you work
onboarding.profileHint: Strengths, recurring traps, coaching preferences. This is your own account, not an assessment, and you can edit it at any time under Memory.
onboarding.consent: I understand where my data goes and the limits described above.
onboarding.consentRequired: Please confirm you have read the privacy notes to continue.
privacy.local: Sessions, memory and settings are stored only in this browser (IndexedDB). There is no account, no server and no analytics.
privacy.provider: During a kata, the conversation and the relevant part of your memory are sent to the model provider you configured, under that provider's terms.
privacy.keys: An API key used in a browser cannot be protected like a server-side secret. It is kept in memory unless you explicitly store it.
privacy.speech: Speech recognition is provided by your browser and may send audio to a third-party service. The app never stores raw audio.
privacy.eviction: Browsers can evict local data. Export a backup regularly; there is no automatic sync between devices.
privacy.noSync: There is no cross-device synchronisation. Move your data with export and import.
privacy.notTherapy: This is a practice tool, not therapy, not an HR assessment and not a diagnosis of any kind.
settings.forgetKeys: Forget all keys on this device
settings.speakFeedback: Read coach feedback aloud in Walk mode
settings.wakeLock: Keep the screen awake during spoken sessions
settings.persistUnknown: This browser does not report whether storage is protected from eviction.
settings.persistGranted: Storage is marked persistent: the browser should not evict it automatically.
settings.persistNotGranted: Storage is not marked persistent and may be evicted under pressure.
settings.backupNoSecrets: Includes sessions, memory, coach dialogues, questions, imported content and settings. API keys are never included.
settings.collisions: If an imported record already exists
settings.restoreSettings: Also restore settings from the backup
settings.importReport: Imported {imported}, kept existing {skipped}, replaced {replaced}, rejected as invalid {invalid}.
settings.heuristic.swotProvisionalAt: Evaluated sessions before a provisional SWOT
settings.heuristic.minScenarioVariety: Distinct scenarios required for a provisional SWOT
settings.heuristic.sampleWarningBelow: Warn about sparse evidence below this many sessions
driving.lead: A short audio briefing built from your last kata and your question library. You only listen and think.
driving.rule.prepare: Set it up and press start before you begin driving.
driving.rule.noInteraction: Once it plays there is a single stop button and nothing to read or answer.
driving.rule.noPressure: There are no simulations, no timed confrontations and no microphone in this mode.
driving.intro: Listening session. Nothing here needs an answer. Keep your attention on the road.
driving.recap: A recap of your last kata: {title}.
driving.questionsIntro: Now a few questions to turn over in your mind. There is no need to answer aloud.
